label: Schools and education
desc: Nursery, primary, secondary and special schools, school meals and community learning

label: Social work and care
desc: Care for older and disabled adults and children's social work, much of it paid to the NHS or to a joint board that runs care together with it

label: Housing and homelessness
desc: Homelessness and temporary accommodation, housing advice and other housing outside council rents

label: Running the council
desc: Finance, IT, legal, collecting council tax and other central costs, less any surplus from the council's trading services

label: Community safety and regulation
desc: Environmental health, trading standards, flood defence and coast protection, cemeteries and crematoria

label: Streets, waste and transport
official_term: Roads & Transport; Road Bridges; Environmental Services (waste)
desc: Bins, recycling and waste disposal, roads, bridges, street lights and support for public transport, after parking income

label: Planning and the local economy
desc: Planning, building standards and economic development

label: Debt costs and levies
official_term: Financing, investment and other operating income and expenditure
desc: Interest and repayment of borrowing and PPP contracts, and building work paid for from the budget, less interest earned

label: Parks, libraries and leisure
desc: Parks and open spaces, libraries, museums, sport and culture
